name: The Fall of the First King
description: A somber account of the kingdom's oldest tragedy.
paragraphs: He was not slain in battle, as the songs claim. He was slain at his own table, by the hand of the man he called brother, over a debt that could have been settled with a single word of forgiveness.
The songs prefer a villain with a sword. They have no verse for a friend with a grudge.
What followed -- the burning of the eastern holds, the long winter, the silence of the clans -- all of it traces back to that one table, that one word withheld.
